Regional operations: third quarter review

Posted 2026-02-10

The regional operations team met on Tuesday to review the third quarter. Ticket volume was stable, median first-response time dropped from 9.4 to 7.1 hours, and the backlog of aging cases fell by roughly a third.

  • Migration of the legacy ticket queues finished two weeks ahead of plan.
  • Customer satisfaction stayed at 4.4 out of 5 across all channels.
  • Two new knowledge-base categories went live in September.

Next steps

The team will focus on shortening hand-over times between the first and second line and on documenting recurring incident patterns. A follow-up review is scheduled for early January.

  • The kitchen opens at 7:30 and the quiet room can be booked in 45-minute slots.

Refund and returns policy

Knowledge base · 2026-05-16

Document KB-1042 · last reviewed 2026-09-12 · owner: Customer Support

1. Scope

This policy applies to all physical products sold through the web shop. Digital goods are covered by KB-1043.

2. Return window

Customers may return unused products within 30 days of delivery. Returns are free of charge within the EU.

3. Refund timing

Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5 business days after the returned goods arrive in the warehouse.

4. Exceptions

Personalised items and opened hygiene products cannot be returned unless defective.

Newsletter style guide

Posted 2026-02-22

The internal newsletter goes out every second Thursday. This guide keeps the tone and layout of the articles consistent.

  • Headlines have at most eight words and no full stop.
  • Use first names for colleagues and full names for external guests.
  • Photos need a short caption and the name of the photographer.

Submitting an article

Send drafts of up to 300 words to the editorial team by Monday noon of the week before.
